item.title: Daily Minute — November 17, 2026
item.description:

item.title: Lesson 137: “When I am healed I am not healed alone.”
item.description: “When I am healed I am not healed alone.” Today’s idea remains the central thought on which salvation rests. For healing is the opposite of all the world’s ideas which dwell on sickness and on separate states. Sickness is a retreat from others, and a shutting off of joining.
